_readme: Arabic and English translations for the Hebrew product text that lives in
WooCommerce. Keys are the normalised Hebrew source string (HTML stripped,
whitespace collapsed) so a changed source string simply misses the cache
and falls back to Hebrew instead of showing a stale translation.
Generated and updated by:  node scripts/translate-catalog.mjs
Safe to hand-edit: a human correction is never overwritten, the script only
fills in keys that are missing.
